prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a vibrant beach volleyball tournament under bright sunlight. In the center, a player in a blue jersey leaps high to spike the ball, their body fully extended. To the left, a referee in a striped shirt stands on a tall chair, watching the play intently. Next to the referee, a spectator in a wide-brimmed hat sits on a cooler, shielding their eyes from the sun. On the right side of the court, a defender in a yellow bikini dives low into the sand, arms outstretched. Behind the net, a coach in a white polo shirt points aggressively toward the opposing team. A brown dog lies calmly near the sideline, ignoring the chaos. Next to the dog, a child in a red swimsuit holds a large bucket of shells. The ball hangs suspended in mid-air, just above the net tape. A vendor in an orange apron hands a cold drink to a woman in sunglasses standing nearby. Two teammates in matching green tops high-five each other near the baseline. A camera operator in black gear kneels on the sand, focusing a lens on the action. A stray seagull perches on a distant umbrella pole. There is no scoreboard visible in the frame. There is no stadium seating surrounding the court.
